page_title: VIL 2-1 ALM | Villarreal v Almeria 17/09/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+8' There will be no more action in this match as the referee signals full time.
90+8' The corner is swung in but Almeria can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.

90+4' 2 - 1 It's a goal! Alexander Sorloth (Villarreal) bursts into the box to get on the end of a whipped in cross from Alberto Moreno and scores magnificently from close range into the bottom left corner. 2:1.
90+2' Yeremy Pino (Villarreal) attempts to discuss the decision with Francisco Maeso, but he soon realises that it's not the right thing to do as he sees the yellow.
90' 6 additional min. will be played.

89' Arnau Puigmal (Almeria) pulls the jersey of one of the opposition players and Francisco Maeso blows his whistle for a foul. Arnau Puigmal (Almeria) earns the yellow card. A free kick has been awarded to Villarreal.
88' Substitution. Luis Suarez is replaced by Ibrahima Kone (Almeria).
88' Shots on target – 3:7.
88' Substitution. Leo Baptistao (Almeria) receives a signal from the referee and is now allowed to enter the pitch as Sergio Arribas walks off.
87' The corner from Dani Parejo (Villarreal) is intercepted by the defence.
85' A substitution has been made. Gerard Moreno goes off and Ben Brereton Diaz (Villarreal) comes on.
84' Chumi (Almeria) is penalised for holding. Francisco Maeso signals a set piece. Villarreal have a free kick. The referee has issued a yellow card to Chumi (Almeria).
84' Pacheta decides to make a substitution. Matteo Gabbia will be replaced by Jorge Cuenca (Villarreal).
84' Juan Foyth (Villarreal) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Luis Maximiano intercepts the ball.
83' Alberto Moreno (Villarreal) gets on the end of a pass on the edge of the box but his shot is blocked.

78' Gerard Moreno (Villarreal) shows good awareness inside the box to meet a delightful cross from the free kick. He fails to direct the ball into the net as it flies narrowly wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Almeria will have a goal kick.
77' The linesman makes the right call and Villarreal will have a corner.
77' A quickly taken corner by Villarreal.
75' Substitution. Gonzalo Melero leaves the pitch and is replaced by Iddrisu Baba Mohammed (Almeria).
75' Vicente Moreno has decided to make a change. Arnau Puigmal (Almeria) replaces Lucas Robertone.
74' The ref blows his whistle and we are going to have a so-called cooling break due to the high temperature.
73' It is time for a substitution. Ilias Akhomach (Villarreal) is on for Alex Baena.
72' Largie Ramazani (Almeria) came close to scoring. He connected with a pass inside the box and perhaps should have done better than direct his shot straight at Filip Jorgensen.
70' None of the Almeria players could reach the corner kick as the ball was overhit and goes out of play.

69' A neat pass is well received by Dion Lopy (Almeria), who is lurking on the edge of the box and strikes the ball towards the roof of the net, but the goalkeeper makes an incredible save to block his shot. Almeria force their opponents to concede a corner.

68' Alex Baena (Villarreal) has a good chance to score with a mid-range attempt after collecting a pass. He aims for the bottom left corner, but he can't generate enough power to trouble Luis Maximiano.
67' Villarreal string together a series of short passes.
66' Substitution. Adrian Embarba makes his way off the pitch and Largie Ramazani (Almeria) comes on as his replacement.
65' He should have scored! Gonzalo Melero (Almeria) gathered a short pass deep inside the box but took too long to shoot, allowing the defender to make the block.
64' A great run from Luis Suarez (Almeria) ends with a shot inside the box that flashes just past the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Villarreal.
63' Pacheta prepares a substitution. Etienne Capoue is replaced by Alberto Moreno (Villarreal).
62' It's time for a substitution. That's the last involvement from Carlos Romero as he is replaced by Santi Comesana (Villarreal).
61' Alex Baena (Villarreal) gets inside the box and tries to beat Luis Maximiano with a measured shot into the bottom left corner, but the keeper is equal to the effort and makes a fine save.

60' Adrian Embarba (Almeria) controls a nice low pass and shoots from just outside the box, but it's a poor effort that flies into the stands. Wasted opportunity! The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Villarreal.
59' Adrian Embarba (Almeria) misses a promising chance to score from the free kick, but Filip Jorgensen makes a decent save.
58' Francisco Maeso blows his whistle for a foul after Yeremy Pino (Villarreal) hacks down one of his opponents. A free kick to Almeria.
53' Francisco Maeso interrupts the game for a tactical foul by Adrian Embarba (Almeria). It's a yellow card for Adrian Embarba (Almeria). There is a free kick near the sideline to Villarreal.
50' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Almeria comes to nothing.

50' Lucas Robertone (Almeria) receives the ball and fires a first-time shot from long range. His brilliant effort towards the left post is blocked by Filip Jorgensen, who pulls off a stunning save! Almeria win a corner.

48' Luis Suarez (Almeria) received a clever through ball which could have put him in a promising position, but the defence was alert to the danger. The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Almeria will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
48' The resulting set piece from Almeria is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.

48' It looks like Etienne Capoue (Villarreal) saw red with that tackle. Francisco Maeso won't tolerate such behaviour on the pitch and blows for a foul. Almeria are given an advantage. They have a free kick.
46' The half-time break is over and the second half is about to start.
45+8' Francisco Maeso has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.

45+7' Alexander Sorloth (Villarreal) receives a quality pass and releases a rocket of a shot from distance, but his amazing effort goes just wide of the right post. The goalkeeper probably wouldn't have saved this one. The ball goes out of play and Almeria will have a goal kick.
45+5' 1 - 1 Goal! Alex Baena plays a simple square pass into the feet of Gerard Moreno (Villarreal) in the box, who composes himself and lashes the ball into the middle of the goal. 1:1.

45+4' Villarreal hold possession of the ball and display neat passing from player to player. They are waiting for the right moment to open up the opposition's defence to hit them swiftly on the break.
45' We will have 6 min. of added time.

44' 0 - 1 Sergio Akieme (Almeria) meets a perfect cross from Lucas Robertone deep inside the box and controls it with a nice first touch. He produces an accurate strike into the bottom left corner via the post. It's 0:1.
41' Villarreal have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
38' Lucas Robertone (Almeria) is moving okay again after that injury scare.
38' Villarreal failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
37' The game is interrupted now, Lucas Robertone (Almeria) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
36' Villarreal take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence. Villarreal have a corner.
33' The referee blows his whistle and players are going to refresh themselves.
32' Lucas Robertone (Almeria) serves up a nice cross, but Filip Jorgensen punches the ball away.

31' Luis Suarez (Almeria) produces an inaccurate low pass into the box that is blocked by the one of the defenders. If this pass had slipped through, the ball would have probably ended up in the back of the net.
26' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Etienne Capoue (Villarreal) was quite harsh and Francisco Maeso didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
24' Adrian Embarba (Almeria) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Filip Jorgensen, who smothers the ball.

23' Villarreal are playing possession football and controlling the game at present. They are exchanging inch-perfect passes from player to player, making it difficult for the opposition to win the ball.
19' Francisco Maeso blows for a foul after Matteo Gabbia (Villarreal) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball. Almeria are awarded a free kick. Let's see what they create from this.
17' Adrian Embarba (Almeria) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
15' Luis Suarez (Almeria) is flagged for offside.
15' Carlos Romero (Villarreal) sends a cross into the box, but Luis Maximiano comes off his line to gather the ball.
13' Villarreal can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
8' Some great controlled play and passing from Villarreal. They are increasing their possession of the ball and trying to open up the opposition's defence to hit them swiftly on the break.
5' Adrian Embarba (Almeria) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Francisco Maeso saw the whole situation. Free kick. Villarreal will probably just try to cross the ball in from here.
4' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Almeria.

3' Luis Suarez (Almeria) beats the defender inside the box and lashes a shot towards the right side of the goal, but Filip Jorgensen makes a brilliant reflex save to deny him. Goalkeeping at its best! Almeria have been awarded a corner kick.
1' The match has just started.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Villarreal will have the kick-off.
Francisco Maeso was nominated as the referee for this game.
